[d0122] config | acktracker.enabled | version 4.x
# `acktracker.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.enabled` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
enabled = true
```

---

# `acktracker.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
batch_size = 100
```

[d0448] config | dlq.compression | version 4.x
# `dlq.compression`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Compression codec that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `zstd` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |

## Notes

Changes to `dlq.compression` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
compression = "zstd"
```

---

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
queue_capacity = 5000
```
